bullets_zh: 实现用于非侵入式EEG的P300与SSVEP脑机接口拼写器。
提供离线分类器训练、浏览器校准和通过LSL实时输出系统按键。
作为实用开源工具，有助于构建BCI通信应用。
bullets_en: Implements a P300 and SSVEP brain-computer interface speller for non-invasive EEG use.
Provides offline classifier training, browser-based calibration, and real-time OS keypress output via LSL.
Matters as a practical open-source tool for building BCI communication applications.

Targets adaptive and non-invasive brain-computer interface workflows rather than implants.

面向使用非侵入式EEG信号的脑机接口应用。
可作为深度学习EEG分类实验的参考代码库。
bullets_en: GitHub project provides a PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for EEG decoding.
Aims at brain-computer interface applications using non-invasive EEG signals.
Matters as a reference codebase for deep-learning EEG classification experiments.

items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK for EEG/BCI Development
bullets_zh: 开源SDK面向ADS1299 EEG采集，覆盖8–64通道硬件及MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA参考包。
包含Verilog RTL以及PC、移动端和Linux集成，支持Python/MATLAB/R分析与BCI工作流。
2026年9月发布于GitHub，构成较完整的非侵入式EEG/BCI开发生态。
bullets_en: Open-source SDK targets ADS1299 EEG acquisition with 8–64 channel hardware and MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA reference packages.
Includes Verilog RTL plus PC, mobile and Linux integration for Python/MATLAB/R analysis and BCI workflows.
Published on GitHub in September 2026 as a broad non-invasive EEG/BCI development ecosystem.
items.brief: ADS1299 EEG采集SDK，提供多通道硬件、软件集成与BCI工作流参考。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK with multi-channel hardware, software integration and workflow references.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

2026年9月发布，可作为分散BCI资源的统一入口。
bullets_en: Curated GitHub resource collecting BCI/EEG open datasets, models and processing methods.
Also archives related news and papers for non-invasive EEG research discovery.
Published in September 2026 as a single entry point to scattered BCI resources.

items.title_zh: 运动想象EEG解码的自监督预训练项目
items.title_en: Self-Supervised Pretraining for Motor Imagery EEG Decoding
bullets_zh: GitHub项目实现面向被试无关运动想象EEG解码的自监督对比预训练。
结合黎曼几何进行少样本校准，并与经典基线进行基准比较。
提供两个Streamlit应用，用于演示非侵入式BCI流程。
bullets_en: GitHub project implements self-supervised contrastive pretraining for subject-independent motor imagery EEG decoding.
Fuses Riemannian geometry with few-shot calibration and benchmarks against a classical baseline.
Provides two Streamlit apps to demonstrate the non-invasive BCI pipeline.
items.brief: 自监督预训练结合黎曼几何，用于少样本运动想象EEG解码。
items.brief_en: Self-supervised pretraining plus Riemannian geometry for few-shot motor imagery EEG decoding.
items.raw_excerpt: Self-supervised contrastive pretraining for subject-independent motor imagery EEG decoding — fused with Riemannian geometry for few-shot calibration, benchmarked against a classical baseline, with two working Streamlit apps.

items.title_en: NeuroHome P300 Smart Home BCI Prototype
bullets_zh: GitHub原型使用EEG和P300信号构建面向智能家居的脑机接口应用。
展示非侵入式P300控制的消费级应用场景。
2026年9月发布，可作为低成本BCI集成的示例项目。
bullets_en: GitHub prototype uses EEG and P300 signals for a brain-computer interface smart-home application.
Demonstrates a consumer-oriented use case for non-invasive P300-based control.
Published in September 2026 as an example of low-cost BCI integration.
items.brief: 基于EEG/P300的智能家居BCI原型，展示非侵入式控制应用。
items.brief_en: EEG/P300-based smart-home BCI prototype demonstrating non-invasive control applications.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG and P300 based Brain-Computer Interface for smart home

items.title_zh: 面向数据高效脑机接口的EEG基础模型
items.title_en: EEG Foundation Models for Data-Efficient BCI
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库blueshark123/eeg_foundation研究EEGPT、LaBraM、BIOT、CBraMod和BENDR等EEG基础模型。
它测试预训练EEG模型能否减少下游BCI分类器所需标注数据。
该资源于2026-09-15发布在GitHub上，与非侵入式EEG脑机接口模型效率相关。
bullets_en: GitHub repo blueshark123/eeg_foundation studies EEG foundation models such as EEGPT, LaBraM, BIOT, CBraMod, and BENDR.
It tests whether pretrained EEG models reduce labeled data needed for downstream BCI classifiers.
Published on GitHub on 2026-09-15; relevant to non-invasive EEG-based BCI model efficiency.
items.brief: 研究EEG基础模型能否减少BCI分类器标注数据。
items.brief_en: Project testing whether EEG foundation models reduce labeled data needed for BCI classifiers.
items.raw_excerpt: This project investigates whether self-supervised “foundation models” for EEG — a rapidly emerging class of models (EEGPT, LaBraM, BIOT, CBraMod, BENDR) pretrained on large unlabeled EEG corpora — meaningfully reduce the amount of labeled data required to train an accurate downstream BCI classifier

bullets_zh: GitHub仓库Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs使用Burn 0.20实现纯Rust的NeuroRVQ推理。
它可在零Python依赖下对EEG、ECG和EMG信号进行tokenize。
该资源于2026-09-15发布在GitHub上，可用于轻量级非侵入式生物信号预处理。

It tokenizes EEG, ECG, and EMG signals with zero Python dependencies.

items.title_zh: EEG微状态教程：研究神经发育中大规模脑网络的瞬时动态
items.title_en: Tutorial on using EEG microstates to study moment-to-moment large-scale functional brain network dynamics in neurodevelopment
bullets_zh: 《神经科学前沿》发表一篇EEG微状态教程，用于研究快速的大规模功能网络动态。
该资源讲解如何利用地形图式EEG模式捕捉全脑组织的瞬时变化。
它可作为非侵入式EEG信号分析（包括BCI相关研究）的开放教学参考。
bullets_en: Frontiers in Neuroscience publishes a tutorial on EEG microstates for studying fast large-scale functional network dynamics.
The resource explains how to use topographic EEG patterns to capture moment-to-moment whole-brain organization.
It is useful as an open educational reference for non-invasive EEG signal analysis, including BCI-related research.
items.brief: EEG微状态教程，讲解分析神经发育中的大规模脑网络动态。
items.brief_en: A tutorial on EEG microstates for analyzing large-scale brain network dynamics in neurodevelopment.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG microstates are topographical patterns of EEG activity that offer a lens into the fast temporal dynamics of large-scale functional network activity and whole-brain functional organization. Microstates can capture temporal patterns of network configurations and transitions between these configurations at the millisecond scale.
